subject: general
question: A hollow spherical shell is made of a metal of density 40 g/cm³ . Its internal and external radii are 1 cm and 4 cm, respectively. What is the mass (in kg) of the shell? (Take π = (22)/(7))
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Mass** = **Volume** × **Density**

Volume of shell = 4/3 × π × (R³ − r³) = 4/3 × 22/7 × (4³ − 1³)

Volume = 4/3 × 22/7 × 63 = 4 × 22 × 3 = 264 cm³

Mass = 264 × 40 = 10560 g = 10.56 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 10.56 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Internal radius** (r) = 1 cm

**External radius** (R) = 4 cm

**Density** (ρ) = 40 g/cm³

**Formula Used:**

Volume of **hollow sphere** (V) = (4)/(3) π (R³ − r³)

Mass (M) = **Volume** × **Density**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/28fdcce4a043a8d817a84ed7fad9906566969c6eb754b88f58203410ef44fc74.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume = (4)/(3) × (22)/(7) × (4³ − 1³)

⇒ Volume = (4)/(3) × (22)/(7) × (64 − 1)

⇒ Volume = (4)/(3) × (22)/(7) × 63

⇒ Volume = 4 × 22 × 3 = 264 cm³

⇒ Mass in grams = 264 × 40 = 10560 g

⇒ Mass in kg = 10560 ÷ 1000 = 10.56 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 10.56 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Solid Sphere

The volume of a solid sphere with radius R is given by V = (4)/(3) π R³.

Surface Area of a Sphere

The total surface area of a sphere is 4 π R².

Density Conversion

To convert mass from grams (g) to kilograms (kg), divide the value by 1000 since 1 kg = 1000 g.</p
